title: The five Cargo source rows the SP-tjap3mdd research added give rust-lang/cargo's licence as MIT OR Apache-2.0, as the other Cargo rows do
goal: kb/public/_sources.csv rows S-miwhfdzy, S-7zyahsl3, S-jdu5egnj, S-uxljwlpn and S-zonbsokp give the licence of rust-lang/cargo as its README and LICENSE files state it (MIT OR Apache-2.0, as the other rust-lang/cargo rows at 797e8a9b say), not Apache-2.0 alone, confirmed against the repository at that sha. Found by the SP-tjap3mdd review (S4).

run: import csv,sys; ids={'S-miwhfdzy','S-7zyahsl3','S-jdu5egnj','S-uxljwlpn','S-zonbsokp'}; rs=[r for r in csv.DictReader(open('kb/public/_sources.csv',encoding='utf-8')) if r['id'] in ids]; sys.exit(0 if len(rs)==5 and all(r['licence'].startswith('MIT OR Apache-2.0') for r in rs) else 1)
